stories.title: Michigan thwarts Mateer, No. 11 Sooners with late INT, go-ahead TD
stories.summary: Jordan Marshall scored on a tiebreaking 1-yard run set up by an interception midway through the fourth quarter as Michigan held on to beat No. 11 Oklahoma.

stories.title: Sources: Stroud, Texans to table extension talks amid looming QB market
stories.summary: The Texans and C.J. Stroud made a run at completing a contract extension before the regular season begins, but both sides agreed they now prefer to wait until after this season to work out a long-term deal, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Chiefs set to use undrafted rookie at LT as Simmons ruled out
stories.summary: Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons is out for Monday's season opener against the Broncos, with Kansas City expected to turn to undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson to help protect returning quarterback Patrick Mahomes.

stories.title: 'Embarrassed for them': Drinkwitz rips Kansas for Border War 'crap'
stories.summary: Missouri coach Eli Drinkwitz had plenty to say after beating Kansas on Friday night, saying he was "embarrassed" for the Jayhawks for leaning into the historic nature of the Border War rivalry.

stories.title: Sources: Raiders TE Mayer lands $45M extension as Bowers sidelined
stories.summary: Tight end Michael Mayer, who is stepping in for an injured Brock Bowers to start the regular season, has received a multiyear extension from the Raiders.
